description: Describe a California drinking water operator exam (grade): what the math covers by topic, the timed practice set format, the size of the problem bank and the official sources (including the CA Exam Conversion Sheet). Without exam and before the user has chosen a grade, lists every available grade with its id. Works signed out. Read-only; changes nothing.

exam.description: Exam (grade) id, e.g. "ca-d2" or "ca-t1". Leave out to use the grade the user saved (save_study_settings); get_exam_overview lists the ids.

name: get_exam_overview
title: Exam overview
